bridge.when: Before time as we know it, then the first days of humankind
bridge.where: The heavens, the Garden, and then the earth
text: This chronicle follows the story of creation and the prophets as the Quran tells it. It begins before there were any people at all: with the heavens and the earth, the angels, and the jinn, beings God made from smokeless fire.
Then God makes Adam, the first human, and tells the angels he will be a khalifah, a steward on earth. Everything that follows grows from this beginning.
